messages:
anna_marketing: Heads-up team: NimbusCore case study interview tomorrow 10:00am PT with their VP Engineering. Goal: blog + short launch post + gated webinar in two weeks. Need hero quote, logo OK, and legal clearance on any metrics. Who can own what?

ben_growth: I can own webinar promos and inbound routing (campaign=nimbus-case). Need final publish URL 48h before webinar to wire nurture flows.

cleo_content: I'll do ASR -> 1-pass edit, produce 3 social snippets and two clips (30s/60s). Need raw audio uploaded ASAP after call.

sam_se: I'll upload raw recording and put markers for timestamps. Also will capture any in-chat confirmation from Nimbus about the numbers.

pat_legal: Reminder: numeric claims need a timeframe or provenance. Send verbatim quote + context to legal-review@redwood.com. Standard review ~48 hours. If partners are named, get explicit permission.

anna_marketing: Timeline proposal: interview -> raw audio same day -> transcript + clips by Fri AM -> legal request Fri AM -> sign-off by Sun EOD -> assets ready Mon. Realistic?

cleo_content: Yep. I'll flag any lines with [CLAIM: verify] and pull a short benchmark clip if they mention throughput/cost.

ben_growth: For routing: if legal delays metrics, we'll still publish blog & social (qualitative) and hold webinar emails. I want blog live to start routing inbound.

assets-bot: Embargo note: placeholder 2026-06-01 08:00 PDT if legal clears by 2026-05-30 17:00.

pat_legal: Also ask Nimbus to confirm logo use and partner names in chat / email so we have a record. If they provide numbers, ask for the comparison period (e.g., "Q1 vs prior infra").

sam_se: Will request on-record confirmation during interview. I'll paste the snippet in this thread after the call and upload files to /marketing/assets/nimbus/4101234567/.

cleo_content: Draft hero options I'll send to legal after transcript cleanup:
1) "NimbusCore accelerates inference and reduces cost with Redwood Inference"
2) "NimbusCore achieves 2.8x inference throughput and 35% lower per-token cost"
Send option 1 for immediate branding, option 2 only if they provide provenance.

pat_legal: Send option 1 for quick approval. Option 2 requires source/context; otherwise we'll recommend qualitative phrasing.

anna_marketing: Great. I'll create the shared folder and add legal + ben + cleo + sam. Post raw link & timecodes here after the call and I'll route to Ben for nurture setup. Thanks all!
